caption: The drawing depicts a round, shallow bowl shown from two perspectives: the top view is above and the side profile is below. The bowl has a reddish-brown color throughout, with a glossy finish indicated by lighter highlights, primarily on the interior. Inside the bowl, there are two wavy, vertical bands of a darker greenish-brown color, each edged irregularly and interspersed with spots of a similar hue, running parallel from the rim to the center. The rim of the bowl is thin and slightly wavy or scalloped, as seen in the side view. The side profile view at the bottom of the drawing shows the bowl as shallow with a consistent reddish-brown color and hints of shadow for depth. The background is a plain light beige, and there is a faint, handwritten inscription near the bottom right corner of the page.
title: Pie Plate
